title: Excel automation and workbook update fragility due Office account/licensing context
notes: Observed repeated workbook corruption and blocked/unstable Excel scripting path while account context may have switched to personal license. Track fixes under JSON intermediary + VBA flow. Circle back to review restored workbook content after account/license is resolved. Build flow now also includes versioning/rollback tasks plus a prod build path in build.gradle; continue using guarded workbook fallback where Excel automation is unavailable.

title: Workbook repair/corruption when managed sheets are added by XML updater without synchronizing docProps/app.xml sheet metadata
notes: Likely trigger: HeadingPairs/TitlesOfParts in docProps/app.xml remained at 2 sheets while workbook.xml contained 3-4 sheets. Mitigation: synchronize extended properties sheet list on every XML update and validate before publish.

title: Excel automation unavailable in headless/agent context (Apple event connection invalid), strict Excel-required mode fails as designed
notes: Validated with AFP_EXCEL_REQUIRED=true: runner hard-fails and does not fallback when Excel automation cannot be used. Observed errors include hiservices connection invalid and AppleScript parse failure under unavailable dictionary context. Default workbook path now pivots to Apache POI (`AFP_WORKBOOK_MODE=poi`) with Excel/XML paths retained as optional fallbacks.

title: Progress Graph sheet visual/layout quality needs tuning despite functional correctness
notes: Workbook opens and graph data is functionally present, but chart/layout presentation is currently suboptimal and should be refined by human tuning preferences. Tickle acknowledged during renderer iteration while workbook artifacts remain in active use.

title: Workbook corruption recurrence control: restore-first protocol and strict no-XML-fallback handling
notes: Recurrence observed. Immediate mitigation: restore workbook from docs/project-plan-progress.xlsx.zip before any further work, avoid XML fallback writes when Excel-native path is unavailable, and require explicit human direction before any non-POI/non-Excel workbook mutation. Added change-driven workbook guard: projectPlanWorkbook now skips when workbook is newer than CSV, preserving human cosmetic edits by default; force update remains available via AFP_FORCE_WORKBOOK_UPDATE=true. Added dedicated boilerplate sync triage workbook generation with preserved manual triage columns to reduce ad-hoc workbook edits and keep merge decisions explicit. Promotion workflow now supports consolidating approved candidates into a single superseding outbound package. Workflow reporting now routes through segmented SQLite state stores (project vs boilerplate) to reduce script fragility and keep updates deterministic. Version-control write mandate now explicitly requires rollback-capable handling for all project-file writes and prompt rollback execution when requested by human.

title: Policy-governance sequence drift when updating constitutional/policy text without full checklist sequencing
notes: Observed a policy update applied before running the full standard governance sequence (issue-log preflight/checkpoint/validation). Corrective action: encode this sequence as explicit first-principles behavior and halt/escalate whenever a step cannot be satisfied. Added dedicated governance-event CSV/XLSX tracking plus SQLite-backed governance alerts, trust-event reporting, mirrored VCS/file-discipline ledgering, and a hard `enforceProjectBoundaries` quality-gate check so product modules cannot import project-management tooling/state.
